participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Brought the water, named the blot, asked about the year and a day, and kept off the lines.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Spoke from the stair, set broth as dinner, and did not come up.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Asleep on the Golding. No lines.
participation.name: Gib

participation.context: Named as having eaten and gone to his loom. Not in the room.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

relations.note: told to keep off the paper

story.body: You sneezed with the pen loaded. The blot was about the size of a groat. You told Alse to keep off the paper and told the stair you were well. Mistress Ansell said broth was dinner, and that Titus dies at two whether you are there or not. You did not go out. Gib stayed on the Golding. Alse asked whether they marry. You said they do not, and you left the half-line empty.
